correct: 4-by-2 oval rotated 90° is congruent, 5-by-2 oval not
Triangle midpoint (-4,1) and centroid (-10/3,2) follow same reflection/translation

equivalent: Fractions 9/4 and 7/2 equivalent to decimals 2.25 and3.5
Any 90° direction produces corresponding rotated oval axes 2,4 with correct center
Complete oral construction with nonvertex correspondences acceptable
Triangle centroid found by average of three reflected vertices
wrong: Only transform trapezoid vertices and ignore midpoint E/F
Treat ovals with major axes 4 and5 as congruent
Apply translation but not reflection to centroid
Accept changed cheek despite unequal distance to nose
Keep E at (2,0) when endpoints translated
malformed: Only E′ given without full trapezoid correspondences
Face drawing without labelled distinguishing cheek

boundary: Corresponding fractions along a segment are preserved under all rigid motions
An oval is congruent after turning its major axis from horizontal to vertical
Distance of cheek from nose is invariant under reflection, despite handedness change
All points, not only polygon vertices, follow the same rigid transformation
A midpoint transforms to midpoint of image endpoints
